title: Renter-Friendly Black & White Accent Wall
headline: Renter-Friendly Accent Wall Ideas: 8 Amazon Finds, Black & White Edition
seo_title: Renter-Friendly Accent Wall Ideas: 8 Amazon Finds | Looks Like Luxe
description: Renter-friendly accent wall ideas from Amazon: trendy peel and stick wallpaper in bold black and cream designs, wall molding, gallery frames, a plug-in sconce and an arched mirror. Eight well-reviewed picks.
intro: You rent. You also have taste. The landlord does not need to know about both at the same time.

I built a black and white accent wall edit that is peel-and-stick friendly: three trendy wallpapers, molding, frames, a plug-in sconce and an arched mirror. Every pick is rated 4.3 stars or higher with real review counts.
Check the product pages for removal notes and your lease before you stick anything permanent, since every wall and every landlord is different.
I haven't tested these. I'm telling you what's well reviewed and renter-minded. Let's give that boring wall a personality.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases, which means if you tap a link and buy, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Prices, colors and availability live on Amazon and change often.

products.name: Tempaper Wiggle Room Removable Peel and Stick Wallpaper, White & Black
copy: Thick black brushstroke squiggles on a clean white ground. It reads like a gallery mural and it is made to be removable.
It rates 4.3 stars from about 485 reviewers.
Verdict: the one that makes the whole room look designed.

products.name: Black and Cream Peel and Stick Wallpaper, Organic Abstract
products.best_for: The organic squiggle in black and cream
copy: Winding cream shapes on black, the organic pattern you keep saving, in a softer cream instead of stark white.
It has a 4.5-star rating from more than 220 reviewers. Check the roll size and sample the pattern first.
Verdict: moody, warm and very of-the-moment.

products.name: Metallic Black and Gold Peel and Stick Wallpaper
copy: A distressed black wall with gold veining. It looks like aged lacquer, a little dark glam.
It rates 4.6 stars from more than 470 reviewers.
Verdict: pick this one for a powder room or a headboard wall.

products.name: Pre-Cut Wall Molding Set, Black
copy: A pre-cut molding set that gives you the paneled, high-end wall you keep seeing on tutorials.
It has a 4.6-star rating from more than 1,300 reviewers.
Verdict: check the install notes and test a small spot first.

products.name: Gallery Wall Frame Set, 9 Piece
products.best_for: The gallery that already has a plan
copy: A matched set of black frames with mats, so your gallery wall looks curated, not chaotic.
They have a 4.4-star rating from more than 1,000 reviewers.
Verdict: print what you love and it looks designed.

products.name: Plug-In Swing Arm Wall Sconce, Gold
copy: A plug-in sconce, so you get the lamp-on-the-wall look without touching the wiring.
It rates 4.4 stars from nearly 600 reviewers.
Verdict: renter-proof glam.

products.name: Arched Wall Mirror, 30 x 40, Black
products.best_for: The shape that softens all the lines
copy: A black-framed arched mirror to hang against the accent wall for light and a curve.
It has a 4.6-star rating from more than 1,600 reviewers.
Verdict: arches make any wall feel finished.

products.name: Large Framed Black and White Abstract Wall Art
products.best_for: The art for a big blank wall
copy: A large framed abstract piece in black and white, for the wall that needs one big move.
It rates 4.5 stars from nearly 750 reviewers.
Verdict: go big on art and keep everything else simple.

interludes.3: Rule one of the renter wall: one bold move, not five.
interludes.6: Rule two: light the wall at night.

outro: And that's the edit: eight Amazon finds for a renter-friendly black and white accent wall.
If you take one thing from this guide, start with the wallpaper. It is the biggest change for the smallest risk.
